people.name: Jordan
people.line: A river and region, significant in Israel's history

translations.web: and every one of your armed men will pass over the Jordan before Yahweh until he has driven out his enemies from before him,
translations.bsb: and if every one of your armed men crosses the Jordan before the LORD, until He has driven His enemies out before Him,
translations.kjv: And will go all of you armed over Jordan before the LORD, until he hath driven out his enemies from before
translations.asv: and every armed man of you will pass over the Jordan before Jehovah, until he hath driven out his enemies from before him,
